status_authority: This adopted file is authoritative; historical boards retain traceability only.

epics.name: Baseline and operating contract
epics.exit: A reproducible starting point and bounded first-slice requirements.

epics.name: User-prioritized 3D visual milestone
epics.exit: Supported normalized neighbourhoods use an improved common visual/inspection system before ML expansion.

epics.name: Thin unified model
epics.exit: Runtime-checked core contracts exercised by fixtures, not 53 new tables.

epics.name: Compatibility and first normalization
epics.exit: Existing records and named input profiles use the new boundary without loss.

epics.name: Mixed-source proving slice
epics.exit: The persisted two-block demonstration and negative tests pass.

epics.name: Shared data/session/viewport architecture
epics.exit: One consistent selection/data boundary with independently releasable render resources.

epics.name: Scene compiler and first streamed renderer
epics.exit: A small real tiled viewport qualifies IDs, geometry, measurements and the pinned engine.

epics.name: Complete-neighbourhood visual quality
epics.exit: Full-map and diverse dataset views pass correctness and user visual acceptance.

epics.name: Cross-area reliability and bounded resources
epics.exit: R1: reusable renderer foundation with measured delivery and recovery.

epics.name: Map interface rebuild
epics.exit: Map workflows meet the shared visual and state contract.

epics.name: Building, floor, unit and evidence interfaces
epics.exit: Plan/model/table/source views agree on the same records and quantities.

epics.name: Import, preparation, editing and review interfaces
epics.exit: A live source-to-record-to-finding journey and correction workflow pass.

epics.name: Integrated product qualification
epics.exit: R2: reproducible supported product, not universal data-format or national coverage.

epics.name: Optional expansion track
epics.exit: R3 increments are elected later; they do not block R1/R2.

tasks.title: Repository branch and fresh preservation baseline
tasks.scope: Re-establish the actual repository, test environment and preservation invariants before editing the product. A cloud checkout and isolated fixtures are valid; PC-only state is a separate gate.
tasks.outputs: Fresh Git/environment manifest; allowed-file boundaries; source/ID/frame inventory; characterized test results.
tasks.acceptance: Known branch and base revision; unrelated work untouched; baseline distinguishes pass, fail and blocked; test database is isolated.
tasks.out_of_scope: Product redesign, migrations against the live database, dependency upgrades and implicit reseeding.

tasks.title: Reference, requirements and fixture acceptance contract
tasks.scope: Reconcile current requirements and the recovered reference packs into named outcomes and capability-specific visual targets.
tasks.outputs: Requirement IDs; reference hash/screen mapping; F01–F09 fixture specifications; declared device and camera suite.
tasks.acceptance: Every primary screen has an anchor or an explicit design gap; dense and sparse inputs have honest targets; contradictory mockup numbers are not requirements.
tasks.out_of_scope: Recreating all UI screens or claiming original-chat completeness.

tasks.title: Architecture decisions and smallest proving experiments
tasks.scope: Resolve only choices that block the thin core: contract authority, legacy boundaries, frame meaning and renderer integration.
tasks.outputs: Short ADRs; contract parity experiment design; keep/adapt/replace inventory; first-slice scope and dependency rules.
tasks.acceptance: One contract authoring authority and one writer per record are nominated; exact unknowns have proving experiments and stop conditions.
tasks.out_of_scope: A new backend, mandatory microservices, a graph database, or committing to all future geometry kernels.

tasks.title: Stable identity, vocabulary and typed relationships
tasks.scope: Define and exercise stable entities/revisions, aliases, non-exclusive memberships and relationships against tiny examples.
tasks.outputs: Runtime-validated identity/relation contracts; legacy namespace rules; no-invention value states; fixture tests.
tasks.acceptance: Rename and retile do not change IDs; a duplex can reference two levels; equal labels are not automatic matches; ambiguous legal/physical links remain unresolved.
tasks.out_of_scope: Automatic fuzzy deduplication or a complete legal registry workflow.

tasks.title: Reusable sources, original assets and exact evidence links
tasks.scope: Represent dataset and source revisions and exact source parts while reusing existing stored originals.
tasks.outputs: Source/asset/source-part contracts; optional many-to-many evidence links; access and retention metadata.
tasks.acceptance: One original can support multiple objects; zero documents is valid; removing one link cannot remove bytes still referenced elsewhere.
tasks.out_of_scope: Copying existing bytes per building, cloud migration or real personal-data ingestion.

tasks.title: Frames, transforms and vertical-reference semantics
tasks.scope: Make units, axes, local origins and vertical meaning explicit; qualify the first supported transform profiles.
tasks.outputs: Frame and operation contracts; source-to-analysis/render transform profiles; independent numeric test vectors.
tasks.acceptance: Metres/feet and rotated local fixtures transform correctly; unresolved vertical ties block dependent 3D comparisons; geographic coverage is not a measurement frame.
tasks.out_of_scope: Relabeling SRIDs, rewriting historical geometry in place or implementing every geodetic operation.

tasks.title: Geometry representations, quantities and capability checks
tasks.scope: Separate analytical and display geometry and implement validators for the first polygon/prism/asset-reference profiles.
tasks.outputs: Discriminated representation and quantity contracts; purpose-specific readiness evaluator; TypeScript/Python conformance fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Holes and multipart geometry survive; unknown is not zero; renderability does not imply volume readiness; unsupported geometry is explicit.
tasks.out_of_scope: Arbitrary-solid Boolean operations or treating an external mesh parser as complete support.

tasks.title: Observations, source composition and coherent snapshots
tasks.scope: Define selected contributions without erasing conflicting facts and bind output to immutable input revisions.
tasks.outputs: Observation/resolution/composition and publication contracts; deterministic input signatures; snapshot/permission rules.
tasks.acceptance: A footprint, level schedule and unit source combine without invented evidence; a failed unrelated contribution does not erase valid output; worlds and revisions do not mix.
tasks.out_of_scope: A universal rule language, arbitrary uploaded code or a full publication service before its first consumer.

tasks.title: Read-only legacy compatibility adapter
tasks.scope: Expose existing physical features, registry records, sources and frames through the new contract without replacing current writers.
tasks.outputs: Small read adapter and first internal consumer; explicit ID crosswalk; parity and unknown-value tests.
tasks.acceptance: Existing IDs, original hashes and historical frame references remain resolvable; old routes keep working; physical and legal records are not collapsed by coincidence.
tasks.out_of_scope: Dual canonical databases, destructive backfills or swallowing unsupported legacy records.

tasks.title: Normalized neighbourhood renderer and shared 3D interface
tasks.scope: User-prioritized complete-neighbourhood renderer/UI increment consuming existing normalized records.
tasks.outputs: Read-only core-to-display scene, bounded derived delivery, shared explorer, improved materials/camera/panels and real browser checks.
tasks.acceptance: Existing geometry, identity and quantities preserved; saved neighbourhood consumes common renderer; actual visual and interaction checks pass with user approval separate.
tasks.out_of_scope: ML extraction, universal bulk import, production authorization, DB publication pointers and replacing every existing workflow.
mandatory_checks: actual browser picking and shared canvas
tasks.blocker: User rejected T057 visuals; T058 adopts the actual City Studio and original mock references.

tasks.title: Minimal additive storage and one-writer migration rehearsal
tasks.scope: Add only persistence required by a demonstrated missing relation or snapshot; test upgrade paths in an isolated database.
tasks.outputs: Versioned migrations and ledger if needed; restart-safe backfill; writer-ownership table; compatibility/rollback experiment.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh and existing databases are tested; rerun does not duplicate; failed migration leaves a defined recoverable state; old/new app compatibility is explicitly checked.
tasks.out_of_scope: Dropping legacy tables, overwriting repository volumes or an ad hoc live database reset.

tasks.title: First supported input profiles and retry-safe normalization
tasks.scope: Wrap the existing bounded GIS and schedule paths plus canonical interchange with the new contracts.
tasks.outputs: Profile descriptors; operation-key semantics; per-item results; source preservation and adapter equivalence tests.
tasks.acceptance: Same input/profile/mapping replay has no duplicate effect; changed mapping is tracked; unavailable profiles fail explicitly; existing safety bounds remain.
tasks.out_of_scope: All IFC/CAD/cloud formats or removing size limits to call the importer scalable.

tasks.title: Persisted two-block multi-source demonstration
tasks.scope: Exercise one real API/storage path from source receipt and composition to the linked two-block scene read model.
tasks.outputs: Executable synthetic fixture; API integration test; expected object graph and analytical measurements; zero-document case.
tasks.acceptance: One 80 m² synthetic building and 480 m³ exterior prism cross blocks without duplicate identity; its levels/units/parcel/utility sources stay traceable.
tasks.out_of_scope: Calling this an actual Uttam Nagar survey or pretending planning arithmetic is a executed test.

tasks.title: Foundation negatives, compatibility and acceptance gate
tasks.scope: Verify the foundation against negative and metamorphic cases before expanding the renderer.
tasks.outputs: Foundation gate report; negative fixtures; old-route regression results; unresolved-risk decisions.
tasks.acceptance: Unknown heights, mixed frames, repeated imports, conflicting sources and private fields behave correctly; no protected baseline invariant regresses.
tasks.out_of_scope: Waiving data loss or using a passing typecheck as complete integration proof.

tasks.title: Shared revision-aware query and invalidation layer
tasks.scope: Deduplicate shared server reads and maintain coherent data by scope, entity and revision while preserving stale-response protection.
tasks.outputs: Shared resource client/cache; keys and invalidation policy; race/cancel/navigation tests; migrated first consumers.
tasks.acceptance: One pending fetch serves compatible subscribers; cancelling one subscriber does not break others; old responses cannot replace newer snapshots; permission changes clear affected data.
tasks.out_of_scope: Storing all server entities in Zustand or silently introducing an unbounded permanent cache.

tasks.title: One map and inspection session
tasks.scope: Extend the existing state boundary for canonical selection, layers, view mode, camera return and selected level/unit.
tasks.outputs: Session model, route synchronization and pure selectors; selection/undo-of-navigation tests.
tasks.acceptance: Map/register/plan return to the same entity and unit; invalid/deleted IDs resolve explicitly; unloaded geometry does not clear a valid selection.
tasks.out_of_scope: A second competing global store or saving private dossiers in browser storage.

tasks.title: Reusable viewport/controller and resource lifecycle boundary
tasks.scope: Separate camera/picking/scene lifecycle from page shells with one stable renderer-facing contract.
tasks.outputs: Shared viewport/controller interface; integration of first two existing views; lifecycle and interaction characterization.
tasks.acceptance: Page changes do not duplicate a full world; inactive contexts release or pause resources; held gestures survive unrelated React updates.
tasks.out_of_scope: An engine rewrite, a hidden screenshot replacing 3D, or specialized views owning different data truth.

tasks.title: Snapshot-to-geometry scene compiler
tasks.scope: Compile supported polygons, holes, building parts and declared height profiles into traceable display geometry.
tasks.outputs: Deterministic compiler stages and manifests; analytical-to-display ID mapping; geometry conformance tests.
tasks.acceptance: Concavity, holes and supported multipart extents are retained; fixed inputs give stable geometry signatures; unsupported shapes remain explicit.
tasks.out_of_scope: Browser-side re-parsing of every source or substituting bounding boxes for supplied geometry.

tasks.title: Road, ground and utility compiler profiles
tasks.scope: Produce first supported surfaces and utility profiles with neighbour context and explicit ground/depth meaning.
tasks.outputs: Road/surface and utility compilation; declared width/profile policy; topology and seam fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Variable widths and junctions do not double physical area; unknown depth stays unknown; overhead crossings do not invent a network junction.
tasks.out_of_scope: Generating measured roads from arbitrary buffers or requiring a complete national terrain dataset.

tasks.title: Deterministic materials and reusable architectural recipes
tasks.scope: Introduce versioned source-preserving, neutral and explicitly illustrative appearance profiles.
tasks.outputs: Reusable material/part vocabulary; stable entity-based seeds; style versioning and derivation signatures.
tasks.acceptance: Changing tile order does not randomize facades; metric texture scale is consistent; illustrative projections do not enter observed analytical geometry.
tasks.out_of_scope: Handcrafting locality-specific render code or adding observed balconies and rooms from a footprint.

tasks.title: First multi-tile delivery and stable feature metadata
tasks.scope: Package a small real multi-tile scene with bounded LOD, canonical-ID maps and a coherent immutable manifest.
tasks.outputs: Tested glTF/3D Tiles delivery subset; local placement, bounds, coarse fallback and ID mapping tests.
tasks.acceptance: A seam-spanning object picks as one entity; tile and LOD IDs are not property IDs; incomplete builds never replace the active manifest.
tasks.out_of_scope: National-scale claims, unbounded all-feature endpoints or optimizing tile size without measurements.

tasks.title: Pinned renderer integration and compatibility qualification
tasks.scope: Load the shared compiled content in the existing product and qualify the actual Cesium/browser versions.
tasks.outputs: Minimal streamed viewport; picking/material/clipping/loading checks; engine decision record.
tasks.acceptance: Navigation, selection, materials and supported clipping work on the pinned stack; concrete blockers are demonstrated before considering another renderer.
tasks.out_of_scope: Declaring compatibility from current online documentation or migrating engines merely for a prettier demo.

tasks.title: Measurement probes and render-foundation gate
tasks.scope: Resolve measurements against the selected analytical representation and verify display independence.
tasks.outputs: Measurement probes; scale/section fixtures; exact-versus-approximate response contract; renderer-foundation acceptance.
tasks.acceptance: LOD, camera and explosion do not change analytical quantities; local synthetic placement meets the declared tolerance; missing exact geometry returns unavailable or approximate explicitly.
tasks.out_of_scope: Measuring cadastral quantities from screen pixels or declaring source accuracy from decimal places.

tasks.title: Complete reference-style neighbourhood through the pipeline
tasks.scope: Generate the entire coherent F01 neighbourhood through the common model/compiler instead of assembling a disconnected hero scene.
tasks.outputs: Multi-tile complete-map candidate with coherent roads, buildings, context and a detailed selected building.
tasks.acceptance: All visible content is produced through shared inputs/recipes; numerical records are internally consistent; multiple camera views reveal complete neighbourhood coverage.
tasks.out_of_scope: One attractive building being marked as the complete-map milestone.

tasks.title: Architecture, facade and material fidelity refinement
tasks.scope: Improve silhouettes, roof/part variation, facade depth and material scale within the declared fidelity policy.
tasks.outputs: One reusable recipe refinement at a time; paired scene-only comparisons; full-map regression captures.
tasks.acceptance: Reverse and close-up views remain credible; narrow spaces retain modeled dimensions; sparse datasets receive a deliberate neutral fallback.
tasks.out_of_scope: Per-building special-case code or moving buildings to achieve a cleaner composition.

tasks.title: Grounding, lighting and alternate-view fidelity
tasks.scope: Tune streets, ground contact, lighting and 2D/section/underground presentation without hiding defects.
tasks.outputs: Fixed camera/lighting profiles; moving-image captures; alternate-state baselines.
tasks.acceptance: No floating/sunken geometry, severe texture shimmer or opaque exterior covering a cutaway; overlays distinguish horizontal clearance and depth.
tasks.out_of_scope: Bloom/blur hiding incorrect geometry or an unrelated 2D illustration.

tasks.title: Dense, sloped, sparse and held-out visual transfer
tasks.scope: Run the same pipeline on F02–F07 and a held-out shape family without locality-specific renderer edits.
tasks.outputs: Dataset/quality-profile matrix; dense Uttam Nagar-style result; capability fallback and seam evidence.
tasks.acceptance: No widening alleys or filling courtyards; missing evidence is explicit; general rules, not locality-specific branches, handle failures.
tasks.out_of_scope: Claiming the held-out data remained held out after tuning to it; replace the holdout after leakage.

tasks.title: Full-map visual acceptance checkpoint
tasks.scope: Review actual unretouched browser output against the approved anchors and independent correctness checks.
tasks.outputs: Per-view comparison and limitations; user acceptance/rejection record; pinned real-render regression baselines.
tasks.acceptance: Every critical applicable scene dimension passes its approved target and the user accepts the scene; no average score hides geometry or interaction failures.
tasks.out_of_scope: Self-declaring user approval or calling a generated mockup runtime evidence.

tasks.title: World coverage catalog and unloaded-entity resolution
tasks.scope: Expand the early multi-tile manifest into permission/scenario-aware coverage discovery and canonical lookup.
tasks.outputs: Bounded coverage/detail endpoints; full-identity resolver; pagination and overlap policy tests.
tasks.acceptance: Search resolves an unloaded entity without loading the whole city; overlapping datasets require an explicit representation choice; unplaced records remain searchable.
tasks.out_of_scope: A universal global all-geometry response or existence inferred from GPU residency.

tasks.title: Bounded loading, cancellation and CPU/GPU release
tasks.scope: Apply a measured budget across all active content and preserve useful fallback during travel.
tasks.outputs: Priority loading/cache lifecycle; cancellation and decode/upload controls; teardown and memory-plateau traces.
tasks.acceptance: Rapid travel cancels obsolete work; coarse context persists; multiple tilesets fit the combined budget; repeated route loops do not show unbounded resource growth.
tasks.out_of_scope: Treating hidden objects as unloaded or a per-tileset cache as a total process budget.

tasks.title: Cross-area seam, topology and precision qualification
tasks.scope: Verify neighbour-aware geometry and frame agreement across multiple authoring areas and render boundaries.
tasks.outputs: Boundary fixtures, world-placement probes, duplicate-pick checks and declared geographic support profile.
tasks.acceptance: No cracks/double roads/identity duplication at seams; supported frame changes preserve quantities; unsupported polar/antimeridian cases are rejected explicitly.
tasks.out_of_scope: Implying worldwide cadastral accuracy from a local Delhi test.

tasks.title: Incremental rebuilds and atomic publication recovery
tasks.scope: Implement durable build/update orchestration and switch coherent publications without cross-store half-states.
tasks.outputs: Dependency invalidation graph; staged immutable assets; transactional publication pointer; job retry/failure recovery.
tasks.acceptance: Interrupted work leaves the prior snapshot usable; duplicate deliveries have one recorded effect; evidence-only changes avoid unrelated mesh rebuilds; stale writers cannot overwrite new revisions.
tasks.out_of_scope: Claiming exactly-once delivery or a database transaction spanning object storage.

tasks.title: Resource/failure benchmarks and renderer release gate
tasks.scope: Qualify a useful declared renderer release using measured visible workload and scale catalogs.
tasks.outputs: Cold/warm timing, memory and failure reports; supported device/dataset profile; R1 decision.
tasks.acceptance: Visual, identity, geometry and resource gates pass together; 10k then 100k catalog stress is explicitly scoped; untested million-feature capacity is deferred.
tasks.out_of_scope: Blocking all useful release on a 1M catalog or presenting catalog size as visible building capacity.

tasks.title: Shared design tokens and map shell
tasks.scope: Build the reference-led map shell around the qualified renderer with shared accessible UI primitives.
tasks.outputs: Tokens, shell/layout and common controls; reference-matched desktop states; loading/empty/error variants.
tasks.acceptance: Actual 3D remains dominant; header and rail proportions match the agreed anchor; no primary action is clipped at supported viewports.
tasks.out_of_scope: Independent CSS themes per page or a new synthetic data store for visual convenience.

tasks.title: Camera, layers and global-search interface
tasks.scope: Expose common navigation and filters without changing identity or analytical scope.
tasks.outputs: Camera/layer/search controls and keyboard behaviour; unloaded-area selection flow.
tasks.acceptance: 2D mode stays top-down; layer hiding does not turn an incomplete analysis into all-clear; ambiguous identifiers require a choice.
tasks.out_of_scope: Owner/resident search in public geometry metadata or assuming visible features are all features.

tasks.title: Property inspector, findings and utility inspection
tasks.scope: Connect canonical selection to defined metrics, exact findings and useful utility sections.
tasks.outputs: Contextual inspector and findings flow; geometry overlays; missing/evidence states.
tasks.acceptance: Actual difference/intersection geometry is shown; overlapping findings are not double-counted; missing depth is not safe clearance.
tasks.out_of_scope: Replacing computed regions with whole-building highlights or prewritten metrics.

tasks.title: Map history, exports and responsive panels
tasks.scope: Add snapshot history and scoped exports with usable desktop/mobile panel behaviour.
tasks.outputs: Read-only history mode; export manifest/scope; responsive drawers/sheets; permission checks.
tasks.acceptance: History stays on one snapshot; export includes definitions and provenance; controls remain reachable with keyboard, zoom and a small viewport.
tasks.out_of_scope: Exporting private files because geometry is public or asserting physical-phone testing from emulation.

tasks.title: Map interface acceptance gate
tasks.scope: Verify every promised map state against the same design and behavioral contract.
tasks.outputs: UI-01–UI-07 evidence map; route/gesture/error regression; known limitations.
tasks.acceptance: Map states meet visual, accessibility and interaction requirements without regressing renderer gates.
tasks.out_of_scope: Calling all screens finished from one hero screenshot.

tasks.title: Building/register composition on the shared model
tasks.scope: Replace the register presentation while preserving the existing linked product workflow.
tasks.outputs: Live building view, summary and record panels using canonical IDs and the shared resource layer.
tasks.acceptance: Exterior-only and zero-document buildings are supported; navigation returns to the correct block and property.
tasks.out_of_scope: Inventing detailed units because the panel needs content.

tasks.title: Floor/unit plans, shared spaces and section interactions
tasks.scope: Derive plan/model/table views from one selected representation and declared relations.
tasks.outputs: Linked level/unit selector; shared plan geometry; section and explosion views; duplex/shared-space fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Same unit is selected everywhere; net/gross/footprint areas have explicit definitions; display explosion does not change levels or quantities.
tasks.out_of_scope: Independent floor layouts in SVG, PDF and 3D or a strict one-level-per-unit tree.

tasks.title: Optional evidence viewers and access scopes
tasks.scope: Attach and display exact source parts at building/level/unit scope without making evidence universally mandatory.
tasks.outputs: Direct/inherited links; versioned viewers/thumbnails/downloads; attachment and unlink flows.
tasks.acceptance: Correct source revision and locator are retained; removing one link leaves other consumers intact; private documents remain permission-scoped.
tasks.out_of_scope: Blob deletion without reference/retention checks or automatic legal acceptance of attached documents.

tasks.title: Record history, issues and investigations
tasks.scope: Expose existing review/investigation lifecycle and history with versioned evidence.
tasks.outputs: History/issue/investigation pages; state transition and stale-decision tests.
tasks.acceptance: Earlier revisions remain navigable; stale evidence cannot silently resolve an issue; source disagreement is not automatically a legal violation.
tasks.out_of_scope: Reinventing a competing workflow state machine for a new page.

tasks.title: Inspection and zero-document acceptance gate
tasks.scope: Qualify register/floor/unit/source flows as one connected product surface.
tasks.outputs: UI-08–UI-12 results; cross-view identity/quantity tests; responsive/keyboard checks.
tasks.acceptance: The complete selection-to-source-to-return flow is coherent with missing, private and absent evidence.
tasks.out_of_scope: Passing only the model or only the table while the combined journey fails.

tasks.title: Import mapping, preview and reconciliation interface
tasks.scope: Make implemented source profiles and candidate/commit stages visible without overstating support.
tasks.outputs: Import/mapping wizard; per-feature status; duplicate/conflict/unsupported guidance.
tasks.acceptance: User sees what was retained, parsed, normalized and usable; repeated imports do not duplicate; incomplete results are not branded fully imported.
tasks.out_of_scope: Advertising every possible source family because an upload accepts bytes.

tasks.title: Source workspace calibration and placement
tasks.scope: Separate document viewing, scale calibration, geographic placement and vertical readiness in the workspace.
tasks.outputs: Plan/source canvas; control-point and independent-check flow; linked candidate geometry.
tasks.acceptance: Scale alone cannot authorize world placement; distorted scans expose residual failures; keyboard/cancel/clear preserve unrelated draft work.
tasks.out_of_scope: Treating two arbitrary dimensions as universal georeferencing.

tasks.title: Versioned geometry edits, undo and conflict handling
tasks.scope: Edit candidates through explicit commands and expected revisions with bounded undo/redo.
tasks.outputs: Draft command model; validation, unsaved/recovery states and concurrent-edit tests.
tasks.acceptance: Undo affects the correct draft; accepted/source geometry is untouched until the controlled operation; stale edits fail without overwriting newer changes.
tasks.out_of_scope: Storing renderer manipulations as authoritative edits or unbounded undo histories.

tasks.title: Compare, build, review and publish workflow
tasks.scope: Connect existing review semantics to the new composition and publication path.
tasks.outputs: Before/candidate comparison; job and review states; safe publication with clear scope.
tasks.acceptance: Build is not review and review is not legal issuance; failed/stale jobs do not replace accepted content; all published results are revision-bound.
tasks.out_of_scope: Publishing directly from AI output or partially loaded client state.

tasks.title: End-to-end import/edit/workflow acceptance
tasks.scope: Prove one repeatable live import and a safe correction path using the already qualified first profiles.
tasks.outputs: UI-13–UI-16 results; upload-to-map-to-register-to-computed-finding journey; recovery test.
tasks.acceptance: Original upload through actual running app works; its demonstrated capability and limits are explicit; correction preserves history and IDs.
tasks.out_of_scope: Blocking this gate on every future adapter or presenting an exterior-only import as automatic interior generation.

tasks.title: Integrated regression and current evidence baseline
tasks.scope: Re-run relevant functional, contract, numerical, visual and resource suites on one release candidate.
tasks.outputs: Revision-pinned aggregate results; failures classified as new/pre-existing/environmental; regression ownership.
tasks.acceptance: No inherited passing report is relabeled as current; all promised first-release profiles have actual qualifying results.
tasks.out_of_scope: Fixing tests by deleting assertions or broad screenshot rebaselining.

tasks.title: Security, input safety and source-use qualification
tasks.scope: Verify the implemented local/operator threat boundary and data privacy before wider distribution.
tasks.outputs: Hostile input tests; authorization/DTO/export review; log and source-attribution checks.
tasks.acceptance: No secrets/party data leak via tiles, errors, logs or downloads; parsers remain bounded; external references cannot initiate uncontrolled fetches.
tasks.out_of_scope: Claiming production multi-user readiness without an implemented and tested identity/access system.

tasks.title: Real device, browser and accessibility qualification
tasks.scope: Verify the supported interaction/device profile rather than assuming emulation equals hardware.
tasks.outputs: Held mouse gesture and physical-touch results where supported; keyboard/focus/zoom/reduced-motion checks.
tasks.acceptance: Browser/device support is stated accurately; supported low-quality profiles preserve geometry truth; untested hardware is not marked passed.
tasks.out_of_scope: Universal compatibility promises or inaccessible drag-only actions.

tasks.title: Reproducible startup, restore and additive transfer
tasks.scope: Qualify setup and recovery with coherent database and source/derived assets.
tasks.outputs: Fresh-environment and additive-upgrade rehearsal; backup/restore and rollback runbook; offline demo requirements.
tasks.acceptance: Restore reproduces the selected publication and its sources; populated environments are not overwritten; missing services/network fail intelligibly.
tasks.out_of_scope: Deleting Docker volumes as a setup fix or calling data-bundle installation continuous sync.

tasks.title: Integrated product release and next backlog
tasks.scope: Release the declared supported subset and document its limits without making optional expansion a hidden blocker.
tasks.outputs: R2 scope/acceptance record; remaining risks and future adapters; pinned regression baseline and rollout decision.
tasks.acceptance: All must-pass gates for R2 are accepted; user-facing visual changes have approval; no data-loss/security blocker is waived.
tasks.out_of_scope: Automatically merging to main or deploying without applicable authorization.

tasks.title: Qualified BIM, city-model and CAD adapter increments
tasks.scope: Choose one requested IFC/CityJSON/CAD version/profile at a time and expand only its declared capabilities.
tasks.outputs: Per-adapter detailed task plans, placement/source-ID mappings, loss reports and fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: Each chosen profile preserves supported semantics and reports unsupported ones; adding a parser requires no new map implementation.
tasks.out_of_scope: Universal lossless BIM/CAD support or legal-flat inference from IfcSpace.

tasks.title: Terrain, point-cloud and survey/bulk increments
tasks.scope: Add useful coverage/survey profiles and their specialized resumable processing paths as separately scoped tasks.
tasks.outputs: Asset catalog extensions; bounded adapters/derivations; no-data, datum, sampling and bulk-recovery tests.
tasks.acceptance: Samples remain in suitable large assets; derived terrain/buildings have lineage; raw GNSS does not directly become parcel geometry.
tasks.out_of_scope: Mandatory point-per-row storage, automatic interiors from LiDAR or raw-sensor completeness claims.

tasks.title: Private parties, official integrations and multi-user expansion
tasks.scope: Plan separately authorized occupancy/registry connectors, real authentication and any mobile/offline workflows.
tasks.outputs: Data agreements and access requirements; distinct Party/Occupancy/RRR/account schemas; separate bounded implementation tasks.
tasks.acceptance: Real residents are not demo fixtures; owners/occupants/logins stay separate; external integration and multi-user claims match actual authorization and tests.
tasks.out_of_scope: Making this a prerequisite for the local renderer or publicizing restricted infrastructure/person data.

tasks.title: Measured capacity and large-catalog expansion
tasks.scope: Increase scale only after the declared workload and bottlenecks are measured.
tasks.outputs: 100k/1M catalog experiments where useful; visible-load benchmarks; resource/cost and operational capacity profile.
tasks.acceptance: Reported capacity states exact workload, hardware, network and limits; source completeness is never inferred from synthetic object count.
tasks.out_of_scope: A mandatory 1M milestone before releasing useful R1/R2 functionality.

tasks.title: Studio-based interface, prepared sources and reference-matched neighbourhood
tasks.scope: Adopt original City Studio, preserve functioning routes, prepare consistent fictional records and refine against original mockups.
tasks.outputs: Studio route, shared viewport, prepared source bundle, working import and review interfaces, side-by-side evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Runtime functionality verified and major source-reference gaps corrected; no fabricated user approval.
tasks.out_of_scope: ML, official identity issuance and replacing real source shapes with synthetic rectangles.

maintenance.title: Delete previously authorized old proof directory
maintenance.boundary: Only this exact resolved directory; reject reparse points/links and unexpected path resolution; preserve product repo, sources and other study directories.
maintenance.authorization: User explicitly approved deleting all proofs in this exact directory; completed through Core.

execution_environment: Windows source/browser verification plus owned GitHub-hosted integration resources
user_priority: Existing-data bridge, then shared 3D scene/UI; ML follows. Original bulk and later release gates remain unaccepted.
